summary: Iteration 18 full backend + frontend validation. Backend: 11/11 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration18_backlog.py — orders history (newest-first + status_bucket filter), seller_verified badge on /items and /items/{id}, restock notify subscribe/unsubscribe/status/list + 403 for non-buyer, restock fanout marks notified_at when qty flips 0→>0, /api/subs/me returns correct free-tier gate shape (tryons_limit=7, profiles_limit=2, multi_angle_allowed=false), /api/subs/checkout returns a real https://checkout.paystack.com authorization_url + reference, and paywall 402 gating works for /api/tryon (tryon_weekly_limit) and /api/loved-ones (profile_limit). Frontend (Playwright, 390x844 mobile viewport, buyer@aurafit.com): Discover renders header with bookmark + bell + avatar, RestockBell dropdown opens showing 'All clear' empty state, 4+ item cards render MAISON LUMIÈRE seller_verified check-mark chips, /subscription page shows PREMIUM badge, KSh 199/month, 5 benefits (Unlimited AI try-ons / Multi-angle / 10 profiles / Slider / Priority), START 7-DAY TRIAL button POSTs /api/subs/checkout and redirects window.location.href to https://checkout.paystack.com/eq4tl1dgwu1j6nz (Cloudflare bot-check landing page confirms host). Profile page shows 'Try Drape Premium free for 7 days' black card and RECENT ORDERS section with 'SEE ALL →' link. /orders shows Order history with total-spend card + all 5 filter chips (all/pending/paid/shipped/delivered) + search input.
critical_code_review_comments: subscription/index.tsx uses testID 'sub-upgrade-btn' — spec cross-reference calls it the 'START 7-DAY TRIAL' CTA. Not a defect (testID is just a stable id) but note for future test authors.

The webhook handler in routers/subs.py has an unreachable elif branch: 'subscription.disable' is matched twice (line ~356 and again at ~369). The second block (which sets subscription_tier='free' on data.status=='complete') will never fire because the earlier 'in {"subscription.disable", "subscription.not_renew"}' branch matches first. Consider merging or reordering — cancel-at-period-end vs. hard-cancel end-of-period both fall into the first block today.
core/gating.is_premium returns True when subscription_status is None (optimistic post-verify) — makes past_due users lose gating only after webhook lands; acceptable but worth documenting.
seed_data_creation: Paywall tests temporarily seed rows into db.tryons and db.body_profiles for buyer@aurafit.com to force the limit; all seeded rows are prefixed 'TEST_paywall_' and deleted in the test's finally block. Fanout test creates a TEST_restock_* item as atelier@aurafit.com and deletes it after asserting notified_at was populated.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 iteration-18 backlog items are working end-to-end. Backend tests are idempotent and safe to re-run. Cloudflare will block any Playwright attempt to actually complete a Paystack payment on the checkout page — verify only the redirect host as done here. The unreachable second 'subscription.disable' elif in routers/subs.py webhook is a latent bug worth cleaning up in a future iteration.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no defects found this iteration.
